subject.title: Add external event hooks for quota and provider state changes

question: Should CodexBar core execute trusted user-configured commands and support these six event names and payloads as a stable external automation contract?
rationale: The implementation has concrete safeguards and proof, but code review cannot decide whether local command execution and long-term event compatibility belong in CodexBar's supported product surface.

options.title: Adopt guarded hooks
options.body: Accept the core feature after account-scoping integration while retaining opt-in enablement, direct execution, minimal environment, coarse errors, and documented compatibility expectations.

options.title: Expose events without execution
options.body: Keep a machine-readable observation surface but remove local process launching from the app and CLI.

options.title: Decline core automation
options.body: Keep CodexBar observational and ask users to poll existing CLI or server output from external automation.

recommendation.title: Adopt guarded hooks
recommendation.body: Accept the core feature after account-scoping integration while retaining opt-in enablement, direct execution, minimal environment, coarse errors, and documented compatibility expectations.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, steipete is the clearest available authority for this permanent product and security boundary.
